requiredRisks.ownerReadableRisk: One Guardian private key can pause and unpause every user swap.
Guardian key compromise lets an attacker toggle pause and disrupt trading.
Lost Guardian key has no recovery or rotation; if paused, users may remain blocked indefinitely without redeployment.
Treasury key compromise can divert fees already received; future fees remain sent to the same immutable address.
USDT issuer blocklist or transfer restrictions are not disproven by empty address code and may prevent fee payment.
Neither immutable Guardian nor immutable feeRecipient can be rotated without deploying and separately reviewing a new contract.

requiredBeforeFutureLaunchAuthorization: A separate explicit owner acknowledgment of every listed risk is required. The direct-EOA preference message does not provide it.
ownershipVerification: Do not claim wallet ownership or key custody unless a deliberate off-chain signature-verification step is separately authorized and completed.
secretCollection: Never request private keys, seed phrases or recovery phrases.
